title: FTP Estimator
description: Estimate functional threshold power from a 20-minute test, plus the 7 training zones.
howto: Ride an all-out 20-minute effort and note your average power in watts.
Your FTP is estimated at 95% of the 20-minute power.
Read the 7 power training zones in watts.

faqs.a: Almost nobody can hold 20-minute power for a full hour. The 0.95 factor converts a 20-minute test to an estimated one-hour threshold power.
The classic Coggan power zones: recovery, endurance, tempo, threshold, VO2max, anaerobic, and neuromuscular, as percentages of FTP.
Every 6-10 weeks, or when training feels systematically too easy or too hard. FTP changes with fitness.
